title: TechOps-Service Mgmt-ITSM-Manager
description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**Service line – Manager:**
 At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**About Global Delivery Services**
 Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
   

  

 Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000\+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
   

  

 Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy \& Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high\-quality, value\-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
   

  

 Enablement Services provides cost\-effective, high\-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
   

  

 Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 You will be responsible for leading mid\-size application managed services engagements, managing stakeholders and contractual obligations as the Service Manager.
   

  

 You will be responsible to execute sound Service management and transition plans by engaging with multidisciplinary teams, and by identifying, managing and mitigating risk
   

  

 You will be responsible to develop relationships across the business to understand requirements, applying business and technical acumen to solve business problems, with the vision to Grow, Sustain and Improve the through strong ITSM principles, process, automation, innovation and better ways of working.
   

  

 You will be responsible for Service onboarding, Service Transition, Service operations using ITSM leading practices for products, applications and services delivered at EY.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Accountable as the point of contact for the service delivery of the Application System
* Enable ITSM processes (Incident, Problem, Change) end\-to\-end
* Ensure service stability, availability, and reliability
* Drive proactive issue prevention \& risk mitigation
* Establish and maintain operational runbooks \& SOPs
* Manage and communicate with key stakeholders on a weekly and daily basis on the operational support of the Application System
* Monitor and ensure SLAs are met, issues escalated and prioritized
* Work with client 3rd party vendors to resolve issues related to the Application System
* Manage a team of Application Developers, Functional testers, Business Analyst, Technical Architects and Platform and DevOps Engineers to manage the Application System
* Execute Managed Services and Implement continuous improvements framework including but not limited to Application Management, Automated provisioning, CI/CD pipeline, etc.
* Work with Build teams to integrate new or enhanced product features for the Application System
* Provide relevant reporting and trend analysis statistics to pro\-actively support and improve the project and operation metrics
* Ensure there are cost controls enabled to avoid leakage
* Coach the team to drive for results applying problem solving skills, architectural thinking, continuous improvements through technology and process and communication efficiency


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
 As the Service Manager with transition experience
   

  

* Strong ITSM process ownership (Incident, Problem, Change)
* Focus on service stability, availability, and SLA adherence
* Drive RCA and proactive issue prevention
* Emphasis on delivery excellence and service reliability
* Lead a motivated and skilled team of Business Analyst, Application Developers and Technical Architects
* Should be conversant with ITSM \& Service Management frameworks
* Execute service transition (knowledge transfer, readiness, stabilization) ensuring smooth shift to steady state
* Manage operational readiness, risks, and coordination across build, vendor, and support teams during transition
* Ability to multitask in fast\-paced environment
* Communication skills (written/oral)
* Willingness to travel


**Ideally, you’ll also**
* Certification in ITIL 4 foundation and higher levels, or Lean\-Six Sigma certifications, or Prince2, or PMP from PMI
* Knowledgeable on Java, or .Net or SaaS products (Guidewire, Salesforce, SAP etc)
* Knowledgeable in cloud based products SAP, Azure/GCP/AWS cloud
* Perform an appropriate role in business development in terms of delivery management and transition and practice development.
* Supervise financial management of engagements to deliver value to clients and to the firm.
* Adoption new outsourcing delivery models \& trends.
* Deliver outsourcing programmes, demonstrate expert consulting skills and advanced level of industry expertise to support delivery to clients
* Demonstrate people management and an ability to lead outsourcing services assignments.
* People capability development and management for the practice.
* Should be willing to work in shifts and on\-call support.


**What We Look For**
* Demonstrated expertise in leading and growing mid\-scale Managed Services engagements
* Strong experience in stakeholder management, ability in liaisoning, troubleshooting and problem\-solving skills with multiple teams with use of complex technologies.
* Proven experience in IT Service Management principles, methods and practices
* Experience Service Designing, Service Transition and
* Confidently articulates Service Management principles and maintains an in\-depth knowledge
* A bachelor's degree, preferably in Computer Science, Information Systems Management, Engineering or similar discipline
* 10\-15 years of experience with minimum 3 years leading mid\-scale Managed Services projects
* Managed muti\-year SOW with contract value ranging from 1\-5 million USD per year
* Managed a reasonably sized team (20\-30 FTEs) across locations, in an onshore\-offshore model
* Experience working in multiple industries preferably Insurance/Financial services/Banking domains
* Executed Application engagements across or one of the technologies \- Java, .Net, Guidewire, Salesforce, SAP products on cloud.
* Should have executed Service Transitions, Service Design and has hands on experience in taking applications to Steady State in Mandatory for more than 3 clients.
* Hands\-on experience in driving services to steady state (3\+ clients)


**What We Offer You**
 At EY, we’ll develop you with future\-focused skills and equip you with world\-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
   

  

 Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
   

  

 To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability\-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
   

  

**Our Commitment:** 
 As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
   

  

**Professional Development** 
 : From entry\-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
   

  

**People and Culture:** 
 In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
   

  

**Benefits** 
 : Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting\-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
   

  

**How to Apply** 
 : If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user\-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.
   

  

 Successful candidates advance to a competency\-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
   

  

 “We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity \& Inclusion”.
   

  

**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.
   

  

 EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi\-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

title: Relationship Manager
description:
**Company Description** 
 Vastu Housing Finance Corporation Ltd., based in Mumbai, is a housing finance company focused on delivering responsible and sustainable credit solutions across India. The organization prioritizes financial inclusion by serving underserved and self\-employed communities in peri\-urban and rural areas, enabling homeownership and long\-term financial stability. Using deep local insights and its proprietary technology platform, Pulse, Vastu provides simple, swift, and customized housing finance solutions that bridge the formal credit gap. As of March 2025, Vastu has supported over 100,000 customers, many with modest monthly incomes and limited documentation, who traditionally struggle to access formal credit. With operations across 15 states and union territories and 340\+ districts, the company offers a decade\-long track record of strong governance, consistent profitability, and robust asset quality.
   

**Role Description** 
 This full\-time, on\-site Relationship Manager role is based in Tamil Nadu, India. The Relationship Manager will manage and grow a portfolio of housing finance customers, guiding prospective borrowers through the end\-to\-end loan lifecycle from lead generation and initial inquiry to documentation, credit assessment support, disbursement, and post\-disbursement relationship management. Daily responsibilities include sourcing new business in designated markets, conducting customer visits, understanding customer income profiles and housing needs, and explaining loan products, terms, and processes in a clear and ethical manner. The role involves coordinating with credit, operations, and collections teams to ensure timely processing, compliance with internal policies and regulatory requirements, and maintaining strong asset quality. The Relationship Manager will also monitor customer accounts, address service issues, encourage timely repayments, and represent Vastu as a trusted partner in local communities.
   

**Qualifications**
* Customer relationship management skills with the ability to build trust, understand needs, and maintain long\-term borrower relationships.
* Business development and sales skills, including lead generation, field sourcing, and closing housing finance opportunities.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills in English and local languages, with the ability to explain financial products clearly and respectfully.
* Basic financial analysis and credit understanding, including assessment of income profiles, documentation, and repayment capacity.
* Familiarity with housing finance, retail lending, or broader financial services, especially in peri\-urban and rural markets.
* Comfort with using digital tools and platforms (mobile apps, CRM systems, and loan management systems) to manage customer data and workflows.
* Ability to work on\-site in the field, travel within assigned territory, and operate independently while adhering to company policies and compliance standards.
* Minimum of a bachelor’s degree in business, finance, commerce, or a related field; prior experience in housing finance or NBFCs is an advantage.

title: Client & Customer Success Executive - B2B
description:
This is a year\-round role owning the customer experience end to end — day\-to\-day individual customer support for most of the year, with added ownership of corporate/B2B client servicing during high\-volume festive periods like Diwali gifting season.
 



  





**What You'll Own** 




 Year\-Round Customer Support
 


* Handle day\-to\-day customer queries across calls, email, and WhatsApp — order status, delivery delays, product issues, complaints
* Resolve issues within defined response and resolution SLAs
* Track recurring complaint patterns and flag them upstream to operations/product teams
* Maintain a clean, up\-to\-date log of all customer interactions and resolutions



 Corporate/B2B Client Servicing (Seasonal Peak — Diwali \& similar)
 


* Own corporate client coordination during bulk/festive gifting cycles — order confirmation, customization requirements, delivery timelines
* Act as the single point of contact for corporate clients through the order lifecycle, from confirmation to delivery
* Coordinate closely with operations/logistics to prevent delays on bulk orders
* Handle escalations from corporate clients promptly and professionally



 Customer Experience \& Retention
 


* Track CSAT/NPS across both individual and corporate accounts
* Identify and follow up with corporate clients ahead of recurring occasions to drive repeat business
* Suggest process improvements based on recurring customer/client pain points



  





**Requirements** 




 Must\-have
 


* 1\-3 years of experience in customer support or client success (D2C or B2B)
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* Comfortable managing both routine customer support and corporate client relationships, especially during peak season
* Organized and able to manage multiple queries/accounts with competing deadlines



 Good to have
 


* Prior experience with bulk/corporate order handling or B2B account coordination
* Familiarity with CRM or ticketing tools (Freshdesk, Zoho Desk, or similar)
